title: Submit Channel Row
description: Per-draft submit instruction. Input row to /api/submit-batch endpoint. Defines which draft, via which channel, using which method.

draft_id.description: run_id of the harness-tailor-output that produced this draft

channel.description: Submit destination type. Determines rate-limit class, sub-cap (LinkedIn), and submit_url shape.

method.description: How to submit. auto-fill-bot = server-side Selenium; userscript = return JSON for user's browser script; manual-paste = clipboard helper; email = SMTP send.

submit_url.description: Optional override of the URL to submit to. If absent, derived from draft.matched_jd_url.

recipient_email.description: Required if method=email. Recipient mailbox address.

additional_question_overrides.description: Per-submit overrides of the candidate's additional-questions answers. Merged on top of the YAML defaults loaded by the submitter.
